subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the given blanks, will complete the letter series.

LK_JIL_ CJ_L_EJILKG_I
solution:
Given :- LK_JIL_ CJ_L_EJILKG_I 

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) A K I K J → L K **A** J I - L **K** C J **I** - L **K** E J I - L K G **J** I

 
• Here, ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84d7b4ce53b6862aced226f6d0abb5cfbce1764b89eb650ff5eea73cf032eebc.png] is repeated.

2) K A I J K → L K **K** J I - L **A** C J **I** - L **J** E J I - L K G **K** I

3) K I J K A → L K **K** J I - L **I** C J **J** - L **K** E J I - L K G **A** I

4) A I J K K → L K **A** J I - L **I** C J **J** - L** K** E J I - L K G **K** I

 
• Option (1) gives the pattern of :- L K A J I - L K C J I - L K E J I - L K G J I

Hence, the correct answer is **"A K I K J".**
